LanguageData.Phinix_store_selectionAction: Click Preview dependency plan above to resolve dependencies.
LanguageData.Phinix_store_inactive: This package is unavailable for dependency planning.
LanguageData.Phinix_store_preview: Browse an HTTPS repository, review dependencies, and install verified new ZIP packages. Enable them in RimWorld and restart. Offline caches authorize browsing only.
LanguageData.Phinix_store_workshopPending: Workshop opening is awaiting Steam integration verification. This preview only shows the listing.
LanguageData.Phinix_store_noInstall: Installation requires confirmation and fresh online checks. Existing packages are never overwritten.
LanguageData.Phinix_store_select: Select a package version to inspect its details.
LanguageData.Phinix_store_state_Idle: Configure a repository endpoint, or open the local JSON test tools.
LanguageData.Phinix_store_state_Failed: Operation failed. The previous valid index remains available.
LanguageData.Phinix_store_offline: Offline cache: browsing and plan preview only
LanguageData.Phinix_store_stale: Previous or expired browsing cache. Withdrawal status needs an online refresh; installation is unavailable.
LanguageData.Phinix_store_state_CheckingPackages: Downloading and checking the frozen package plan…
LanguageData.Phinix_store_state_PayloadsVerified: All new ZIP packages passed static checks. Nothing installed.
LanguageData.Phinix_store_install: Install new packages in this plan
LanguageData.Phinix_store_installConfirm: Install the following packages? Files will be written to local Mods after online and payload checks. Nothing is enabled automatically; enable the mods and restart RimWorld afterwards.
LanguageData.Phinix_store_managedRefresh: Refresh installed packages / recover unfinished operations
LanguageData.Phinix_store_uninstallConfirm: Remove this store-owned package? First disable it in RimWorld’s Mods list and restart if its DLL has been loaded. Dependent packages and modified files block deletion. Saves and plugin settings are preserved.
LanguageData.Phinix_store_state_Installing: Downloading and staging packages; checking the online index again…
LanguageData.Phinix_store_state_Committing: Committing the filesystem operation. Cancellation is unavailable during this short phase.
LanguageData.Phinix_store_state_Installed: Installed. Enable the new mods in RimWorld’s Mods list and restart to discover and activate them.
LanguageData.Phinix_store_state_Managing: Checking owned packages and recovering unfinished operations…
LanguageData.Phinix_store_state_Uninstalled: Package uninstalled. Restart RimWorld to refresh its mod list. Saves and settings were preserved.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_choose: Select a plugin to see its description, compatibility and installation actions.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_workshopNotice: Steam manages subscription, download and activation of complete mods. The store provides a listing and link.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_refreshFirst: Refresh the store to load its catalog.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_confirmInstall: Install these plugins and dependencies. Phinix manages their DLL files and enables them after a game restart. Plugin code has game-process access; install only publishers you trust.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_confirmUninstall: Mark this plugin for removal before loading on the next startup. Only verified owned code is removed. Settings, business data and saves are retained.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_reviewAgain: The catalog or plan changed. Review dependencies again.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_offlineNotice: Offline cache is for browsing. Refresh online before installing.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_state_PlanReady: Dependency checks passed. Continue installation or confirm dependencies.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_state_Verified: Download and static validation passed. Not installed yet.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_state_Installing: Downloading, rechecking and installing. A decided commit completes the entire batch.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_state_Installed: Installed. Restart the game and check loading in the extension manager.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_state_Canceled: Task canceled. An installation with a durable commit decision will finish.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_localIdentityNotice: Local mod inspection needs attention before a plan can be created.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_referenceNotice: The plugin requires a different CLR assembly identity. Use a package built for this game/framework version.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_referenceMissing: Not present in the host snapshot
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_accessHint: Use the GitHub / CF button to switch access method and retry.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_cfEndpoint: CF endpoint (not used by GitHub direct)
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_foreignInstallation: This plugin is managed by another repository. Use Extension manager to manage it; switching access methods does not move installations.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_replacementUnavailable: You are viewing another version. Version replacement is not available yet; the controls below manage the installed version.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_dependencyConfirmation: This installation includes dependencies. Confirm the following plugins; they take effect after restarting the game.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_failedFriendly: The operation could not be completed. Open error details for help.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_networkFriendly: Cannot reach the repository. Switch GitHub / CF access and retry.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_rateLimitedFriendly: Too many requests. Wait a moment, then refresh again.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_compatibilityFriendly: This plugin or the local environment needs a compatibility check. See error details.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_catalogEmpty: No plugins are listed yet. Refresh later.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_blockedFriendly: A dependency or local state prevents this action. Manage related extensions first; technical details follow.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_progressCommitting: Saving installation; restart required after completion
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_updateAvailable: A newer version is available. Review its changelog; updates are never installed automatically.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_updateNotice: Updates are available for {0} plugins. Click to open the store.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_updateConfirmation: Update these packages? Changes take effect after restarting. Plugin settings are retained; this does not migrate or roll back plugin data.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_downgradeUnavailable: Installing an older version over this package is unavailable.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_enableBeforeUpdate: Enable this package before updating; packages awaiting removal cannot be updated.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_accessExplanation: GitHub and CF show the same catalog. Switch access if the connection is slow.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_restartHint: Changes take effect after restarting the game.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_workshopFooter: Subscribe and manage this mod in Steam Workshop.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_stateSaved: Changes saved. Restart the game to apply them.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_managedBadgeTip: Install, enable and remove this DLL plugin through Phinix. Changes take effect after restarting the game.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_workshopBadgeTip: This is a full RimWorld mod. Subscribe and manage it through Steam Workshop and the game mod list.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_externalBrowserRequested: Requested the system browser; the Steam overlay is unavailable.
LanguageData.Phinix_store2_linkUnavailable: Could not open the browser. Check your Steam overlay or system browser settings.
